jobs.occupation: (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search / AI Forge (Data Scientist)
jobs.description: Über diesen Job:CHECK24 is the comparison portal: We are both the market leader and a dynamic startup. Working in agile teams, we make fast decisions and embrace flat hierarchies. By leveraging the latest tools and technologies as well as state-of-the-art AI methods, we drive data-driven innovation – always focusing on creating added value for our customers. Across more than 50 products, we work every day to continuously improve the user experience of our more than 20 million customers.Our Search Team within CHECK24 AI Forge develops scalable AI solutions for search and ranking across different CHECK24 products. Search is a crucial entry and navigation point for our customers and covers challenging domains ranging from e-commerce product search and web-style navigation to travel search for hotels, destinations and other products.Search and Ranking are among the most demanding disciplines in applied machine learning. A successful system needs to understand user intent, retrieve relevant candidates, rank them effectively and meet demanding requirements for latency, scalability and measurable customer impact.To strengthen our team, we are looking for someone with first relevant hands-on experience who is eager to grow into a strong Applied Machine Learning Engineer. In this role, you will work on production systems combining classical information retrieval, deep learning, embeddings and Large Language Models and contribute across the entire lifecycle from initial idea and evaluation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.We look forward to receiving your application as a (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search at CHECK24 AI Forge GmbH.Was Du mitbringst:- You have successfully completed a degree (typically a Master's) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, electrical engineering or a comparable quantitative field, with strong grades in quantitative subjects- At least one year of relevant hands-on experience in machine learning or data science is part of your background, including relevant experience gained through working-student positions, internships or your own projects- Strong Python skills and practical experience with machine-learning or deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch are part of your technical toolkit- Solid classical machine-learning skills like gradient boosting, regression and feature engineering are evident in your CV, beyond LLM or RAG applications- You have practical experience with applications based on Large Language Models, LLM evaluation, tool use or agentic workflows- A solid understanding of machine-learning fundamentals and systematic model evaluation enables you to assess and improve model performance- Practical experience with APIs (e.g. FastAPI), containers and Git, ideally a deployed service, complements your interest in building complete production services- Knowledge of information retrieval, semantic search, recommender systems or learning-to-rank approaches is a plus- You have English proficiency at C1 level or higher; German is a plus but not requiredZu Deinen Aufgaben zählen:- You develop and improve machine-learning services for retrieval, ranking, query understanding and classification- Hybrid search solutions combine lexical retrieval, embeddings, neural models and components based on Large Language Models- Model development covers training, fine-tuning and systematic evaluation for semantic search, relevance prediction and learning-to-rank use cases- You create reliable evaluation datasets and metrics and validate improvements through offline evaluations, user signals and A/B tests- Production-ready services are built from prototypes using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, PyTorch and vector databases- Modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows enable efficient prototyping, testing and continuous improvement- You research promising approaches in information retrieval, recommender systems and Large Language Models and translate them into measurable customer impactWas wir Dir bieten:Development and responsibility- Your commitment pays off – we support your talent and provide opportunities to grow your career quickly- Take ownership of your topics, contribute your own ideas, try new approaches and gradually assume responsibility for production Search and Ranking systems- Benefit from internal training with specialized coaches as well as an annual budget for external professional developmentTeam spirit and modern workspace- Experience team spirit in your daily work and beyond, whether over lunch, a game of table football or after-work activities, and celebrate our successes at regular company and team events- Work in an inspiring environment with a modern office and high-quality equipment such as MacBooks and height-adjustable desksFlexibility and balance- Fridays are home-office optional – and spending them in the office can earn you additional vacation days on top of your 28 days- Get to the office conveniently with your free Deutschlandticket or a subsidized company bicycle- Enjoy a free fresh lunch twice a week and use the opportunity to connect with your colleagues- Stay active with our internal sports classes or take advantage of our subsidized external sports offering, including EGYM Wellpass

jobs.description: What to ExpectThe Tesla EMEA Indirect Procurement team is looking for a highly motivated Supply Chain Manager to support procurement for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across the broader EMEA region. You will partner closely with Engineering, Facilities, Finance, and operations stakeholders to source and manage complex service, supplies and equipment spend — from engineering consultancies, test and lab services, and specialized technical support through to engineering equipment, tooling, and infrastructure investments. This role requires a hands-on buyer who can drive end-to-end sourcing, negotiate commercial terms, ensure compliant purchase-to-pay execution, and keep critical engineering and capital programs on schedule and on budget.What You’ll Do- Serve as the primary Indirect Procurement partner for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment demand across EMEA, translating business requirements into clear scopes of work, sourcing strategies, and executable purchase packages.- Lead end-to-end sourcing for engineering services (e.g., design/engineering support, testing, prototyping services, technical consultancy, and specialized lab/operations support) and engineering supplies (e.g., lab consumables, non-production hardware, development materials) and equipment categories (tooling, fixtures, facility and infrastructure investments).- Own RFx processes (RFI/RFP/RFQ): develop bid packages, run competitive tenders, evaluate commercial and technical proposals, and present award recommendations that balance cost, lead time, quality, risk, and supplier capability.- Dive deep into supplier quotes and statements of work to challenge scope, pricing structures, rates, milestones, and total cost of ownership; negotiate best cost, payment terms, warranties, SLAs, and commercial protections.- Ensure supply activation and on-time delivery for engineering development activities and capital projects, proactively managing bottlenecks, change orders, and expedites.- Partner with Engineering, Facilities, Finance/FP&A, Legal, and Compliance to align budgets, approval thresholds, contract terms, and capital equipment spend governance requirements.- Manage the full purchase-to-pay lifecycle for assigned categories: requisition triage, PO creation/release, goods receipt / service confirmation support, invoice issue resolution, and spend compliance.- Build and maintain a capable regional supplier base for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across EMEA; drive preferred-supplier strategies, framework agreements, and multi-site leverage where beneficial.- Track category spend, savings, cost avoidance, and risk; report status, escalations, and opportunities to Supply Chain leadership and key stakeholders.- Work collaboratively at a cross-functional level with Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Supplier Industrialization, Legal, Finance, and other Supply Chain teams to deliver seamless operational support.- Uphold Tesla procurement policies, ethical standards, and audit readiness across all sourcing and contracting activities.What You’ll Bring- You live and breathe procurement. You take ownership of assigned buying demand and ensure Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment needs stay in control from intake through delivery and payment.- You possess a higher vocational or university qualification in a subject such as automotive engineering, mechanical engineering or business management, or equivalent experience- Specific diploma’s Supply Chain/Purchasing are preferred- Proven 5+ years of experience in Indirect Procurement, with hands-on ownership of Engineering Services and/or engineering equipment categories (equipment, tooling, technical services, project-related spend).- Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or high-tech engineering environments is preferred; familiarity with plant/lab operations at a gigafactory or similar large industrial site is a plus.- Strong commercial acumen: able to interpret complex SOWs, rate cards, and multi-year service proposals and negotiate cost, terms, and risk allocation.- Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders across Tesla operations specifically in the wider EMEA region; experience with cross-border sourcing and multi-currency contracting is advantageous.- Working knowledge of P2P / ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and standard procurement governance (DOA, capital expenditure approval flows, contract lifecycle).- Analytical, structured, and hands-on — equally effective running a strategic tender and resolving day-to-day PO, delivery, or invoice issues.- Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills; ability to lead high-stakes contract discussions, challenge constructively and drive decisions at pace.- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus.Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.Job Responsibilities1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time- Proactively monitor planning quality and process consistency; coordinate planning activities with Finance, HR, and global Sales Operations as required- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries7. Sales Incentive Compensation- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and ITQualifications & Experience- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels- Deep understanding of the DACH business landscape, commercial culture, and regulatory environment- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) — additional language skills in French or Italian are a plusHomeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
